paper_title: Performance and Stability of Polymer: Nonfullerene Solar Cells with 100 °C-Annealed Electron-Collecting Combination Layers
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/ChemSusChem - 2021 - Lee - Performance and Stability of Polymer   Nonfullerene Solar Cells with 100  C‐Annealed/auto/ChemSusChem - 2021 - Lee - Performance and Stability of Polymer   Nonfullerene Solar Cells with 100  C‐Annealed.md

knowledge_points.content: The study utilizes a hybrid electron-collecting buffer layer (ECBL) system consisting of a zinc oxide (ZnO) and poly(2-ethyl-2-oxazoline) (PEOz) blend (ZnO:PEOz) with an additional PEOz interlayer.
knowledge_points.evidence: Inverted-type organic solar cells, fabricated with low-temperature-processed combination layers of hybrid electron-collecting buffer layers (ECBLs) consisting of zinc oxide (ZnO) and poly (2-ethyl-2-oxazoline) (PEOz) and additional PEOz interlayers, showed improved performance and stability.

knowledge_points.content: The ZnO:PEOz/PEOz combination layers were processed at a low thermal annealing temperature of 100 °C to be compatible with roll-to-roll fabrication on flexible substrates.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this study, we have attempted to further reduce the thermal annealing temperature down to 100 °C for the ZnO:PEOz hybrid ECBLs and form the PEOz interlayers on the low-temperature-processed ZnO:PEOz Iayers.

knowledge_points.content: Inverted PBDB-T:IT-M solar cells using a ZnO:PEOz (6 wt% PEOz) / PEOz combination layer achieved an average power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 10.11% and a maximum PCE of 10.59%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Results showed that the power conversion efficiency of solar cells reached approximately 9.38 and 10.11% (average) in case of the ZnO/PEOz and ZnO:PEOz (6 wt% PEOz)/ PEOz combination layers, respectively... a maximum PCE of 10.59% could be achieved from the PBDB-T:IT-M solar cells with the ZnO:PEOz/PEOz combination layers at the PEOz content of 6 wt%.

knowledge_points.content: The inclusion of 6 wt% PEOz in the ZnO precursor minimizes the series resistance (Rs) to 0.13 kΩ, which correlates with the highest observed short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 16.19 mA/cm².
knowledge_points.evidence: The highest Jsc value can be explained by the lowest series resistance (Rs = 0.13 kΩ) at the PEOz content of 6 wt% (see Figure S5 and Table 1)... the shortcircuit current density (Jsc) was gradually increased as the PEOz content increased up to 6 wt%.

knowledge_points.content: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) revealed that the ZnO:PEOz (6 wt%) layer possesses a textured surface with nanocrater structures, which increases the interfacial contact area with the bulk heterojunction (BHJ) layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: As observed from the atomic force microscope (AFM) images in Figure 3, the textured surface with some nanocrater structures in the ZnO:PEOz/PEOz combination layers (6 wt %) might extend the area of interfacial contacts with the BHJ layers so that the electron transfer from the BHJ layers could be enhanced.

knowledge_points.content: Under continuous one-sun illumination for 12 hours, the device with the ZnO:PEOz (6 wt%) / PEOz layer showed a 35.27% reduction in Jsc, whereas the device with the ZnO / PEOz layer (0 wt% PEOz) showed a much higher reduction of 68.72%.
knowledge_points.evidence: However, the reduction of short circuit current density (ΔJsc) after 12 h exposure was 68.72 and 35.27% for the 0 and 6 wt % solar cells, respectively. This pronounced difference supports the positive influence of the hybrid combination layers.

knowledge_points.content: The appearance of a sigmoidal (S-shape) J-V curve, indicating severe degradation, was delayed from 2 hours to 4 hours of continuous light exposure by using the 6 wt% PEOz hybrid combination layer instead of the pristine ZnO layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the case of 0 wt % solar cells (ZnO/PEOz combination layers), the J-V curve became gradually poor with the irradiation (exposure) time in the evolution of noticeable sigmoidal shape after 2 h... but the sigmoidal shape appeared after 4 h [for 6 wt%], which is a two-fold extended time.

knowledge_points.content: Optical absorption measurements indicated that the PBDB-T:IT-M active layer undergoes photo-induced degradation, with absorbance at 700 nm decreasing by 18.23% (for 0 wt% PEOz) and 17.24% (for 6 wt% PEOz) after 12 hours of illumination.
knowledge_points.evidence: The reduction ratio (Abs) of absorption peaks was 23.48% at λ = 630 nm and 18.23% at λ = 700 nm in the case of 0 wt % PEOz content, while it was 21.42% at λ = 630 nm and 17.24% at λ = 700 nm in the case of 6 wt % PEOz content.

knowledge_points.content: Polymeric interlayers like PEOz function by creating dipoles on the metal oxide surface, which modifies the work function and increases the built-in potential of the organic solar cell.
knowledge_points.evidence: It has been reported that the interlayers in the inverted-type polymer:nonfullerene solar cells play a crucial role in increasing the built-in potentials of devices via work function changes caused by the formation of dipoles on the metal oxide layers (ECBLs).

knowledge_points.content: The ZnO:PEOz precursor solution was prepared using zinc acetate dihydrate and PEOz in 2-methoxyethanol with ethanolamine as a stabilizer, followed by stirring at 60 °C and a 24-hour sol-gel aging process at 25 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: The ZnO:PEOz precursor solutions were prepared by mixing zinc acetate dihydrate (100 mg) and PEOz... in 2-methoxyethanol (1 mL) in the presence of ethanolamine (28 μL). The precursor solutions were stirred at 60 °C for 3 h and then kept at 25 °C for 24 h for completing sol-gel reactions.
